EditTextPreference.title: Read-only API Key
EditTextPreference.dialogMessage: Create a System-generated, Read-Only API key in Bybit Dashboard → API → Create New Key. Enable permissions: "Bybit Card" (transaction history), "Earn → Earn" (redeemable Flexible Earn balance), "Wallet → Account Transfer / Subaccount Transfer" (Funding balance), and "Exchange → Exchange History" (Funding coin valuation). Do NOT enable trading or withdrawal permissions. Paste the API Key here.

EditTextPreference.title: Read-only API Secret
EditTextPreference.dialogMessage: Paste the API Secret that was shown once when you created the API key. The secret is used to sign requests with HMAC-SHA256 and is never sent to Bybit in plain text.

EditTextPreference.title: Bybit API region
EditTextPreference.dialogMessage: Use the official API host for your Bybit account region. Examples: https://api.bybit.com, https://api.bybit.kz, https://api.bybit.eu.

EditTextPreference.title: Card funding coins
EditTextPreference.dialogMessage: Comma-separated list, e.g. USDT, USDC. Include only stablecoins selected in Bybit Card → Paying With with Auto-Deduction enabled. The USD account balance combines their Funding value, redeemable Flexible Earn availableAmount, and Funding USD fiat 1:1. Bybit's public API does not expose the Auto-Deduction switch. Only USDT and USDC are supported.
